Cihan Motors

Service Advisor

Apply Now
Dohuk, Iraq Full Time Human Resources (HR) Due 27/11/2026 (10 days left)
Apply Now
Advertisement
Cihan Auto-Trading Company is looking for a bright and aspiring Candidate for the following vacancy:
Position:                 Service Advisor
Hours:                      8 Working Hours- 6 Days per week (Sat-Thu)
Location:                Duhok, Kurdistan Region- Iraq          
Duties and responsibilities:
  • Maintain a professional work appearance with designated work wear and always sport a smiling face
  • Meeting and greeting customers when arriving for their service in the Service reception area
  • Ensure that all the points of GOG are strictly always adhered to
  • Ensure vehicle cleanliness through use of vehicle protection materials (seat covers, floor mats, etc.)
  • Propose proper maintenance service to customer after checking the vehicle condition, mileage and service history in DMS
  • Ensure speedy maintenance and repair through clear identification of customers’ needs and accurate repair order preparation
  • Liaising effectively with the Team Leader and Workshop Controller to receive updates on the work progress and keep customers informed of changes to cost and or completion times.
  • Explaining to customers any additional repairs that will need to be carried out on their vehicle, as well as description of their repairs and estimated cost
  • Create clear precise customer invoices that show and itemize all parts, labor and lubricant charges
  • Assisting with customers payments
  • Ensure that all outstanding payments are followed up and cleared monthly
  • Handling customer complaints
  • Utilize the Service Appointment system to maximize the facility and manpower capacity
  • Actively promote the services and benefits of the dealer's service and parts departments to all customers
  • Take all necessary actions to resolve customer complaints in the shortest possible time
  • Carry out the service delivery to the customer with a high emphasis on clear job explanation and associated charges                    
  • Ensure all customers vehicles are clean and ready according to the promised completion time
  • Keeping the DMS system up to date by filling out all service orders and repairs that have taken place and also with updated / correct customer contact details
  • Make sure to maintain Proper documentation process (filings)
  • Ensure all filing are completed with necessary documents and are archived up to date (including customer history files and regular purging of inactive customer files)
  • Conduct customer service reminders
  • Confidently communicating with customers in regards to booking/scheduling their vehicles in for a service appointment using the Auto-Line system                                                                                    
  • Working alongside other members of staff including the Service Manager, Workshop Controller and other Service Advisors in order to keep a smooth-running service department at all time
  • Complying with all company Health and Safety procedures.



 Education, Job Requirements & Skills:
  • Proficiency in English & Kurdish & Arabic (Speaking, Reading, and writing) is a Must.
  • Bachelor's degree/institute graduation or any related field.
  • Minimum 2 Years' experience in relative position.
  • Computer Knowledge.
  • Excellent interpersonal and verbal/written communication skills with a customer-service focus
  • Strong organizational, decision-making, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution abilities, alongside a warm and professional visitor-greeting manner.
  • Ability to work under pressure.
  • Meet tight deadlines, and accept additional responsibilities as needed.
  • Honest, ethical, and dependable..
    To apply:
  • Interested applicants are encouraged to fill out the job application form by clicking the link below: 
  • Select Service Advisor/DHK/89-11-26
  • Only short-listed candidates will be contacted.
  • Application deadline:  27/ 11 / 2026.
